raw.excerpt: Manulife Financials’ Group Benefits is a leading provider of employee Group Benefits for more than 16,000 organizations across Canada.
raw.description:
Manulife Financials’ Group Benefits is a leading provider of employee Group Benefits for more than 16,000 organizations across Canada. We provide coverage for businesses of all sizes, from two employees to Canada's largest employers. Group Benefits provides a broad range of coverage including health and dental care, emergency travel assistance, short- and long-term disability, group critical illness, absence management services and wellness products, flexible benefit plans, life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment coverage.

The Service Relationship Specialist role represents Manulife externally with existing and potential corporate clients (large and jumbo) as well as our key Advisor Firms and Partners. They work alongside the Account Executives in this client facing role and supports our distribution partners in the delivery of value-added benefits and superior service to Plan Advisors/Consultants and Plan Sponsors. This role requires advanced skillset in the corporate space to accelerate growth in our book of business, perform tasks required and be proficient in retaining corporate clients. This team owns collaboration with internal service providers such as Customer Experience, Underwriting, and Implementation, Plan Document Services, Sponsor Financial Services, Plan Member Administration, and our Admin Advantage Flex Benefit Teams to provide exceptional service to new and existing corporate clients ranging from 400 lives to 80,000+ with premium $1M to over $100M+ for our largest National corporate clients. Working with our largest Consulting firms in the Group Benefits industry across Canada, experience and expertise in this field will be paramount. Enthusiasm for delivering client presentations and leading client meetings is a must for being successful in this role.

Individual Responsibilities:

Support – 35%

  • Support Distribution partners in the acquisition of new business; participate and present in finalist presentations and implementation meetings. Assist internal partners in acquiring new business by serving as a liaison; take part as a subject-matter expert in the short-list presentations and ongoing meetings for implementing new business.

  • Respond to benefit plan inquiries and resolve escalated and complex inquiries from Plan Sponsors, Plan Advisors/Consultants, and internal department contacts. Owning and respecting the unique demands of each customer while being considerate of the time frame ensuring a thorough response.

  • Champion for a successful outcome for all involved, the Service Relationship Specialist role is responsible for the successful resolution and negotiation of all service escalations. Advocate for a favorable conclusion for all parties. All service escalations must be successfully resolved and negotiate by the Service Relationship Specialist.

  • Initiate Amendment requests ensuring that information is complete and outstanding requirements are obtained in a timely manner to meet deadlines and meet effective dates of plan changes. Includes ability to understand, explain and outline complex structures for large corporate Clients. Union negotiations and costings of plan designs discussions often come into play.

  • Collaborate with our Customer Experience/Operations teams to facilitate information-sharing and identify key issues with our online customer.

  • Assist with general internal initiatives related to Group Benefits services, products, and procedures.

  • Facilitate multiple meetings with our Plan Advisors/Consultants and Plan Sponsors as well as internal teams.

  • Take on special projects and/or research assignments for corporate client needs.

Advise – 35%

  • As the face of Manulife, you build and maintain successful and lasting relationships with existing and potential partners.

  • Understand the intricacies and complexities of each Plan Sponsor's Group Benefits designs and the sophistication of the Advisors/Consulting houses.

  • Prepare and analyze and interpret client reports for review.

  • Generate client reports using web analytics platforms via various reporting tools, requiring analysis and comparison of many reports to ensure we are fulfilling our customer’s needs.

  • Provide expertise on Manulife’s digital experience for group benefits clients (Web, mobile, voice), and highlight key features and functionality.

  • Support group benefits clients in driving adoption of our digital tools and experiences among their plan members

  • Provide reporting on digital uptake/usage to help group benefits clients understand overall plan health and identify areas of opportunity for education/engagement.

  • You drive results by reviewing special requests and helping promote and sell products and services based on client needs and your unit’s business objectives and strategies.

  • Establish and maintain client relationships by identifying current or potential needs and promoting client retention.

  • Providing recommendations on plan design, service options, technology solutions and any ongoing administration needs to the client.

  • Applies understanding of legislative and privacy guidelines to assist in client meetings.

Educate – 30%

  • Deliver presentations to employee groups to facilitate enrolment and/or introduce their Group Benefits (in person or remote).

  • Meet with plan administrators to train and educate them on effective methods of plan administration.

  • Lead customer workshops and training around product updates & new features

  • Maintain direct contact with clients/advisors, proactively planning your client meetings to ensure regular connections are made.

  • When new products are launched in Group Benefits, take the Lead together with the Account Executive to learn, present and speak to these new services. Become the expert in delivering and educating clients on these services and how it affects their population and what amendments are required to their plans if any.

  • Using our Seismic Tools to put presentations together to present and deliver our services to clients.

  • Clients rely heavily on the Service Relationship Specialist on how to manage new services and products that are launched, or on any new legislative initiatives.

  • Coaching mindset and abilities enabling to define solutions and delivering outcomes.

Shared Responsibilities:

  • Works with a Team of Account Executives and collaborates with other Service Relationship Specialists.

  • Assist new Service Relationship Specialists with Job Shadowing and Buddy system to ensure all members of the team can successfully represent Manulife Group Benefits Services on the corporate market.

Job Requirements:

  • Extensive Group Benefits knowledge and experience.

  • In-depth knowledge and understanding of the Group Benefits products and services.

  • Building and strengthening existing client and consultant/advisor relationships.

  • Proven ability to take initiative, be a strong self-manager and display integrity.

  • GBA designation or working towards the designation.

  • Understanding of funding arrangement, underwriting concepts, risk analysis and financial reporting.

  • Strong technical and demonstrated analytical skills using Microsoft Office Products, Excel and/or PowerPoint, Web Analytics platforms, to arrange and display relevant information during customer business reviews.

  • Excellent presentation skills and the ability to influence decision makers in various areas of organization.

  • Supports, participates, and presents in corporate Finalist Presentations to attain new and keep existing business out to Market.

  • Strong customer-facing skills including expectation management, communication skills, information management.

  • Ability to work independently and in a team setting, self-starter, innovative thinking with a keen eye for results and driven by quality.

  • Outstanding analytical, strategic, and problem-solving thinking ability – enabling the candidate to recognize issues, outline possible implications and suggest solutions.

  • Relationship-oriented; must be comfortable working with a wide range of individuals at different levels, managing across, up, and down and self-manage to meet timelines of multiple priorities.

  • Capability to determine sensitive client needs or issues.

Jupe is looking for a creative wizard of digital design. You are an individual searching for a new challenge at the crossroads of hardware and digital. Someone that is passionate about designing magical user moments that embody Jupe’s whimsical and nomadic aesthetic.

You are a rising superstar looking to make their mark on the universe with epic design

Be a good human being or at the very least a nice tourist while visiting this planet

Training durations range from three (3) days to ten (10) weeks, with an average of four (4) weeks. The Flex Learning Specialist may be assigned training responsibilities for varying lengths of time, typically not exceeding six (6) months within a twelve (12) month period. Once training is completed, the Flex Learning Specialist will resume the duties of a Customer Service Agent.

While in Training, this position is responsible for planning, preparing, and delivering training to Foundever Customer Service Agents for one or more clients using diverse learning methodologies including classroom instruction in a learner-led environment, active classroom techniques, small and larger group activities and self-directed learning. This position also requires one-on-one mentoring and coaching of Customer Service Agents, as part of the agents’ learning experiences.

  • Provide training reports, including account training needs, classroom progress, individual agent progress, and other performance tracking as requested by management.

  • Communicates with leaders, support agents, and client representatives using clear, professional language, both written and orally

  • Mentors and provides customer support, escalation support or coaching during On-the-Job training, as required.

  • Successfully complete (pass) all Training Programs and certifications as required by the Client or Foundever Learning and/or Compliance Teams

  • Assist with delivering corporate training initiatives, as required

  • May perform other additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

As a Customer Service Agent, you will serve as the primary point of contact for our customers, providing exceptional service and support. Your role will involve handling customer inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive experience. You may communicate with customers through various channels, including phone, email, and chat.

Fluency in English and French is required, as the role involves handling calls and providing administrative support for program operations in both languages.

  • Achieve individual performance goals set by leadership, including but not limited to response times and customer satisfaction ratings.

  • Participate in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge

  • This dual role requires you to maintain good standing in both positions, meaning you may not be placed on a written warning or higher or be placed on a Performance Improvement Plan and remain in this dual role.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Associates (AA) Degree preferred but not required. Two years’ experience in training/teaching/coaching preferred or a combination of contact center experience and training/teaching/mentoring/coaching.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Be in good standing; not have received a written warning or higher in the last 12 months or be on a Performance Improvement Plan

  • 90% schedule adherence on current program is required

  • Passion for learning and development, with a focus on creating a positive impact.

  • Strong Communication and Presentation Skills

  • Excellent facilitation and presentation skills.

  • Strong coaching skills, with a focus on and passion for developing others

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage large groups of people.

  • High level of creativity and innovation in facilitating learning solutions.

  • Adaptable and flexible, able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  • Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking ways to enhance learning experiences.

  • Open to feedback and committed to personal and professional growth.

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivering results.

  • Proactive and self-motivated with the ability to work independently.

  • Proficient in data analysis and interpretation to inform learning experiences.

  • Microsoft Office Suite Proficiency including but not limited to Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Office

  • Strong computer and software navigation skills including ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues is required

  • Strong leadership skills and be able to escalate issues and motivate others for timely resolution with little or no direction

  • Ability to collaborate with multiple departments to drive successful outcomes

  • Must meet Foundever and Client Facilitator Certification Requirements

  • Flexible work schedule, ability to train nights, days and weekends with training shift varying from class to class or when covering another Learning Specialist as back-up, as needed.

  • Willing and able to travel (up to 25%)

This role sits at the intersection of data strategy and applied machine learning, owning the end-to-end data lifecycle that fuels natural language processing (NLP) applications and large language model (LLM) development. You'll define what "good data" looks like for a range of NLP use cases, build the guidelines and pipelines to get there, and partner closely with data engineering, data science, and ML teams to turn high-quality annotated data into measurable model performance gains.

This is a full-time W2 position. You would be employed by Cyborg Mobile but placed with our client working full-time there and reporting to a manager there. We're looking for someone who is a self-starter, self-sufficient, and able to execute with little direction. This is a remote position (Washington candidates preferred).

What You'll Do

  • Conduct market and user research to understand data needs and expectations across various NLP applications and domains
  • Define data specifications, scope, and sourcing strategy for each use case and domain
  • Design judgment guidelines and instructions for data annotation, validation, and quality control
  • Deliver datasets, schemas, guidelines, and annotations that meet approved specifications, scope, and sourcing requirements
  • Manage the end-to-end data annotation process
  • Analyze data quality metrics (accuracy, consistency, coverage, and diversity) and turn findings into actionable recommendations
  • Implement approved data quality improvement actions
  • Collaborate with client data engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to integrate annotated data into production pipelines, support LLM fine-tuning, and evaluate model performance and impact
  • Identify data gaps and opportunities; propose new data sources, methods, and features to improve data quality and model outcomes
  • Communicate data vision, strategy, and results to internal and external stakeholders, including product owners, engineers, researchers, customers, and partners
  • Prepare and deliver data reports, presentations, and demos using client-approved formats and channels

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in NLP data strategy, annotation program management, or a related data quality/linguistics role
  • Strong understanding of data annotation workflows, guideline design, and inter-annotator quality control
  • Familiarity with LLM training/fine-tuning pipelines and how annotated data feeds model evaluation
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate quality metrics into concrete improvement plans
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills — comfortable presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience working in large, matrixed corporate environments

Must Haves

  • Customer centric
  • Good with follow through
  • Has skills to build Agents, PowerBI dashboards, Sharepoint list management, coding agents like Codex, Claude Code, Github copilot

Role Overview

The HR & AI Systems Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for shaping and evolving Fortive’s HR technology ecosystem. Reporting to the Director of HR Technology (Engineering & Platform), this position sits at the intersection of HR systems, enterprise integration, and AI innovation, leading architecture decisions across Oracle HCM Cloud, Boomi, ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, LMS platforms, and the broader IT landscape.

This role is the primary technical authority for HR platform architecture — defining how systems connect, how AI augments HR workflows, and how data flows reliably across the enterprise. The architect partners closely with HR Product Owners, IT/Enterprise Architecture, and vendor teams to deliver scalable, future-ready solutions that support Fortive’s operating companies and HR functions globally.

Core Technology Landscape

  • Oracle HCM Suite
  • Boomi Middleware
  • ServiceNow HRSD
  • Eightfold AI Platform
  • LMS Solutions
  • Integration APIs
  • Power BI Reporting
  • Oracle Analytics

Key Responsibilities

1. HR Systems & Platform Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end architectural design of Fortive’s HR technology landscape, including Oracle HCM Cloud (Core HR, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, Benefits), ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, and LMS platforms.
  • Develop and maintain architectural blueprints, data flow diagrams, and modernization roadmaps aligned to cloud-native, API-first principles.
  • Establish design standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across the HR tech portfolio.
  • Partner with IT’s Azure-based infrastructure teams to ensure HR systems align with enterprise architecture standards and security posture.

2. Integration Architecture & Engineering

  • Define and drive integration strategy across HR systems, moving from point-to-point patterns toward reusable, API-first services.
  • Lead architecture and hands-on implementation using Boomi (atoms, molecules, connectors, process routing) as the primary middleware platform.
  • Design scalable integration patterns — real-time APIs, event-driven integrations, and batch/file-based flows — connecting Oracle HCM to Eightfold, LMS, payroll, benefits, and IT/ERP systems.
  • Maintain data integrity, auditability, and compliance (GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA) across all integration flows.
  • Supervise and guide integration developers through the full development lifecycle, including code reviews, design reviews, and documentation standards.

3. AI Solutions & Automation

  • Identify and deliver high-value AI and automation use cases across the HR lifecycle — intelligent onboarding, workflow automation, AI-assisted case triage, talent insights, and conversational self-service.
  • Architect and implement AI capabilities within Oracle HCM Cloud, Eightfold’s talent intelligence platform, and ServiceNow HRSD.
  • Build and prototype solutions leveraging HR-specific AI platforms, taking ideas from POC to production.
  • Embed AI/ML, NLP, and chatbot capabilities into HR workflows and digital employee experience channels, aligned with enterprise AI governance standards.
  • Establish AI performance monitoring and responsible AI frameworks for HR use cases.

4. Data Architecture & Governance

  • Design HR data models, master data management (MDM) strategies, and data lineage documentation in partnership with Data Engineering and BI teams.
  • Enable secure, governed access to HR data for analytics (Power BI, Oracle Analytics).
  • Define and enforce HR data contracts, quality standards, and privacy controls across all systems and integration points.

5. Stakeholder Leadership & Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to HR leadership, Product Owners, and IT on HR technology architecture, AI strategy, and platform decisions.
  • Translate complex architecture and AI concepts into clear business outcomes tied to KPIs and strategic priorities.
  • Provide technical guidance on vendor selection and partnership for Oracle, ServiceNow, Eightfold, and integration tooling.
  • Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, L&D, Total Rewards) to embed AI capabilities within HR programs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10–12 years of progressive experience in HR technology and enterprise systems architecture.
  • Must be available to work full U.S. Eastern Time (EST) hours each day.
  • Deep expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud, including integrations, HCM Extracts, Security, and configuration across at least three functional modules.
  • Proven experience with Boomi or a similar enterprise integration platform (Dell Boomi preferred), including building and supporting production integrations.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, including REST and SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, synchronous and asynchronous processing, and data transformation.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying AI/ML and automation solutions within HR or other enterprise business systems.
  • Experience delivering AI/ML and automation solutions within HR systems.
  • Experience with digital assistants or AI-driven employee experience platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with ServiceNow HRSD, including case management, virtual agent, and HR service delivery configuration.
  • Experience leading or mentoring small technical teams, including integration engineers and developers.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Eightfold AI or comparable talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience with LMS platform architecture (e.g., Absorb, Cornerstone, or similar).
  • Background in Agile/SAFe delivery, DevOps practices, and CI/CD for integration pipelines.
  • Experience with RPA tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere) and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Oracle Analytics Cloud, or enterprise BI architecture for HR data products.
  • Knowledge of enterprise AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you will have mapped the current HR architecture landscape, identified integration gaps and technical debt, and proposed a prioritized modernization roadmap. Within the first year, you will have elevated integration maturity toward API-first and reusable services, shipped at least two meaningful AI-powered HR use cases into production, and established architectural standards that guide the broader HR engineering team.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Fortive and all Fortive Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at .

Bonus or Equity
This position is also eligible for bonus as part of the total compensation package.

Pay Range
The salary range for this position (in local currency) is 114,100.00 - 190,500.00

Our use of recruitment matching AI technology

We use an AI-powered tool, provided by Eightfold AI, Inc. in our recruitment process to help us in providing you the ability to view the most relevant jobs that are matched to your skills and experience. Senior Director, Resource Planning & Operations Analytics

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Resource Planning & Operations Analytics provides enterprise leadership for the integrated resource management function, encompassing Workforce Management and Operations Analytics. This leader directs the long- and short-range forecasting, capacity planning, staffing, scheduling, intraday management, operational analytics, business intelligence, performance reporting, and resource optimization capabilities that enable the organization to meet service, quality, turnaround-time, productivity, client, and financial commitments. Working through Directors and other people leaders, the Senior Director aligns workforce strategy and analytical insight across business units, operating models, and work types, translating complex demand, workforce, and operational data into clear decisions and sustained business results.

Organizational Scope & Leadership

  • Provides strategic direction and accountability for the Workforce Management and Operations Analytics teams, including the Directors who lead those functions.
  • Owns an enterprise resource management operating model that connects demand, capacity, workforce supply, skills, schedules, productivity, cost, quality, and customer or client commitments.
  • Exercises significant autonomy in decisions that shape functional strategy, policy, investment priorities, and operating effectiveness over a multi-year horizon.
  • Partners with executive leadership, Operations, Finance, Technology, Human Resources, Implementation, and Client Management to reconcile competing priorities and enable coordinated execution.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Establish and execute a multi-year strategy and annual operating plan for resource planning and operations analytics, aligned to enterprise objectives, growth plans, and changing business needs.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Directors and managers responsible for Workforce Management and Operations Analytics; build succession strength, functional depth, and a culture of accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Set the integrated forecasting strategy for short-term, medium-term, and long-range demand, workload, staffing, and capacity plans; ensure assumptions, methodologies, and outputs are transparent, actionable, and routinely recalibrated.
  • Direct workforce planning, hiring models, staffing strategies, skills planning, scheduling standards, and capacity management so resource supply is aligned with anticipated work demand and budget expectations.
  • Oversee intraday and near-term resource optimization across inbound, outbound, digital, case, fax, and other offline work, including the timely movement of resources as demand, backlog, system conditions, and performance risks change.
  • Ensure Workforce Management practices support contractual and operational requirements, including service level, average speed of answer, turnaround time, quality, utilization, productivity, and client performance commitments.
  • Guide the design and use of scheduling, workload routing, queue management, and contingency practices that optimize employee availability, cross-functional resource sharing, and business continuity.
  • Direct enterprise operational analytics, business intelligence, reporting, and performance measurement programs that give leaders an accurate, common view of operational health, risk, opportunity, and results.
  • Sponsor executive dashboards, scorecards, and performance narratives that translate complex data into concise, decision-ready recommendations and quantify the expected operational and financial impact.
  • Establish governance for data definitions, metric ownership, reporting standards, forecasting inputs, analytical methodologies, documentation, and quality controls to strengthen trust in enterprise reporting.
  • Advance the use of predictive analytics, scenario modeling, simulation, optimization, automation, and self-service reporting to improve planning precision, speed of decision-making, and scalability.
  • Identify and lead cross-functional initiatives that improve productivity, resource utilization, process flow, customer and provider experience, service delivery, and cost management.
  • Partner with Finance on labor budgets, headcount plans, workforce investment decisions, productivity targets, business cases, and variance analysis; communicate tradeoffs and recommendations to executive stakeholders.
  • Provide resource planning support for new business, implementations, growth initiatives, operating-model changes, and technology deployments, including demand assumptions, capacity implications, and readiness requirements.
  • Ensure effective escalation, communication, and analytical support during significant system, demand, staffing, or operational events; help leaders understand service and financial exposure and coordinate mitigation actions.
  • Cultivate strong partnerships with Technology and data teams to prioritize platforms, data assets, integrations, and tools that improve the efficiency and reliability of WFM and analytics capabilities.
  • Benchmark performance, practices, and technology against industry standards; anticipate emerging risks, regulatory considerations, and operating trends and translate them into proactive functional improvements.
  • Own functional budget, resource allocation, vendor and technology priorities, and portfolio delivery; ensure investments produce measurable value and align to strategic commitments.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred in Business, Operations, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Healthcare Administration, or a related quantitative or operational field.
  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in workforce management, resource planning, operations analytics, business intelligence, or a related operational discipline.
  • 8+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers and multiple teams or disciplines.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Expert knowledge of workforce management principles, including demand forecasting, capacity planning, staffing models, scheduling, intraday management, queue and backlog management, and resource optimization.
  • Advanced understanding of operations analytics, business intelligence, performance measurement, predictive modeling, scenario analysis, and data storytelling.
  • Strong command of both short-term operational forecasting and long-range planning, with the ability to link forecast accuracy, capacity risk, staffing actions, and financial outcomes.
  • Ability to create governance frameworks that improve data quality, metric consistency, analytical rigor, and confidence in executive reporting.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen, including labor cost management, budget planning, business-case development, investment prioritization, and productivity analysis.
  • Experience with workforce management, analytics, visualization, and data tools, such as IEX or comparable WFM platforms, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, SAS, Python, R, or similar technologies.
  • Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations, decisions, and action plans.
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, solve complex and abstract business problems, and balance short-term service needs with long-term strategic priorities.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships, negotiate tradeoffs, and drive alignment across diverse functions, business units, and leadership levels.
  • Commitment to developing high-performing teams, advancing analytical and operational capability, and fostering an inclusive, accountable, service-oriented culture.

raw.description:
About Landing

We are a nationwide hospitality platform where fully-furnished apartments meet hotel quality and consistency. Guests access a curated selection of thousands of high-quality apartments available for any length of stay in hundreds of cities nationwide.

By blending the best of hospitality and everyday comfort, every unit is designed with all the amenities of home backed by 24/7 local support. For a week-long getaway or an extended adventure, We deliver a familiar and frictionless guest experience that’s perfect for any travel occasion, for work or pleasure.

For property owners, We offer a fast path to new revenue and higher occupancy in just weeks by tapping into our nationwide demand for furnished, hospitality-grade housing. We provide a turnkey solution that covers the entire unit experience, from furnishings to guest turnover and everything in between, with zero operational lift from partners. We handle it all so partners can unlock value faster.

The Role

We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic pricing leader to own revenue optimization across our rapidly growing portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of data science, strategy, and execution, responsible for driving measurable impact on occupancy, revenue, and profitability.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Operations to shape pricing decisions at the home, market, and network level.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own pricing and revenue optimization strategy for all homes, balancing occupancy, rate, and contribution profit.
  • Enhance and scale our machine learning–driven pricing model.
  • Develop and deploy dynamic pricing logic for lifecycle stages (launch vs. mature), stay lengths, and distribution channels.
  • Build and maintain pricing and performance dashboards using Python, SQL, and Looker.
  • Run elasticity tests, scenario modeling, and pacing analysis to guide decisions with a test-and-learn mindset.
  • Integrate external data sources (AirDNA, CoStar) into pricing strategies.
  • Partner with Marketing on channel mix and ROAS tradeoffs, ensuring OTA vs. direct pricing alignment.
  • Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership to influence revenue and investment decisions.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7–10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, or data analytics (ideally in hospitality, travel, or other perishable-inventory industries).
  • Hands-on fluency with revenue management systems and multi-property pricing strategies.
  • Experience building or managing algorithmic or ML-based pricing systems.
  • Deep understanding of price elasticity, occupancy forecasting, and RevPAR optimization.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to distill complex analyses for executives.
  • High bias for action and comfort operating in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with OTA pricing or channel management (Airbnb, Expedia, Booking.com).
  • Familiarity with CoStar or AirDNA datasets.
  • Strong Python skills (pandas, statsmodels, etc.) for building revenue analytics and modeling.
  • Ability to design and interpret statistical tests to balance revenue and conversion outcomes.
  • Experience in high-growth startups or tech-enabled real estate.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation + stock options
  • Comprehensive benefits — Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and AD&D, Disability, Mental Health, Pet, Commuter, FSA or HSA
  • 401(k) plan and access to ImmediatePay
  • Generous PTO policy
  • Opportunities for upward mobility — we want you to grow with us
  • $750 annually in Landing Stays

Landing is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, and related conditions, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service or obligation, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.
Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?We’re looking for a CRM Data Analyst who can turn customer, campaign, and transactional data into clear commercial insights. You’ll sit at the intersection of CRM, loyalty, data, and restaurant operations, helping teams understand what is driving customer engagement, retention, and value.

You’ll be comfortable working independently with large datasets, asking the right questions of the data, and turning open-ended analytical briefs into practical recommendations that influence business decisions.

What Will You Do?

  • Analyse CRM and campaign data across Braze to measure acquisition, engagement, retention, LTV, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Interrogate customer and transactional data to identify behavioural trends, purchase patterns, and opportunities.
  • Conduct restaurant-level analysis across order frequency, average basket value, transactions, and different store formats.
  • Compare performance across Equity vs. Franchise and Drive-Thru vs. Non-Drive-Thru locations.
  • Build benchmarks and identify underperforming restaurants, customer segments, campaigns, and operational areas.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable commercial recommendations for CRM, Loyalty, and Restaurant Operations teams.
  • Build intuitive Power BI dashboards and reporting that make insights easy for stakeholders to understand and act on.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics, Data Engineering, CRM, Loyalty, and Operations teams to access and validate relevant datasets.
  • Investigate open-ended business questions, structure the analysis, and take findings from brief to action.
  • Contribute to a broader data-driven approach to customer engagement, loyalty, and restaurant performance.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Strong experience as a Data Analyst, CRM Analyst, Customer Analyst, or similar analytical role, ideally within CRM, loyalty, retail, QSR, or consumer businesses.
  • Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently query, join, clean, and analyse large datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Strong Power BI or BI tooling experience, with the ability to build clear dashboards and reporting.
  • Solid understanding of CRM and loyalty analytics, including customer lifecycle, segmentation, retention, LTV, campaign performance, and engagement metrics.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as Braze and analysing campaign/customer data.
  • Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to turn analytical findings into practical recommendations and business actions.
  • Comfortable working with transactional, customer, app, and behavioural datasets and analysing performance at a granular level.

At Oviva, we’re on a mission to make sustainable, personalized, clinically effective care accessible to everyone.

We’ve already supported over one million people across the UK, Switzerland, Germany, and Poland – and we’re just getting started. Every conversation, coaching session, and line of code brings us closer to a healthier future. Join us, and be part of the team making that future possible.

As an Obesity Care Co-ordinator you have experience in a healthcare setting and will be an integral part of our Tier 3 Weight Management team, working in close partnership with the Consultant Endocrinologist to provide coordinated, patient-facing support.

You will work directly alongside the Consultant Endocrinologist, taking ownership of appointment management, patient scheduling, and administrative coordination to ensure the Consultant's caseload runs smoothly and efficiently

Responsibilities

  • Delivering high quality specialist care coordination to patients enrolled in our Tier 3 Weight Management programme, under the clinical oversight of the Consultant Endocrinologist

  • Ensure key treatment and outcome data is kept up to date for treatment and audit purposes
  • Work with other team members to develop and refine efficient patient systems and workflows
  • Work closely with the Patient and Clinical Services teams to ensure a smooth patient journey from onboarding to discharge
  • Act as a point of contact for all administrative support within the Consultant Endocrinologist's team

Requirements

Essential:
  • Experience in a healthcare setting, ideally within patient services, specialist clinics, or clinical administration
  • Confidence working alongside senior clinicians, including consultants, in a fast-paced specialist setting
  • Strong ability to handle sensitive data and a great attention to detail
  • Good understanding of Information Governance procedures to ensure the security of patient data
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Competent user of IT equipment and essential software (email, word processing, data entry and interpretation)

  • Ability to thrive in challenging, fast-paced situations

  • Ability to prioritise your workload based on business needs
  • Passion for providing digital treatment & support
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills with the ability to manage complex patient cases
Desirable:
  • Previous EMIS experience
  • Experience of managing a large patient caseload in a specialist or secondary care setting

Benefits

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in revolutionizing healthcare
  • Exciting and rewarding role in the high-growth environment
  • Training and development opportunities, with a personal learning allowance
  • We embrace flexibility & remote working
  • We provide a home working allowance to enable you to set up your workspace in a way which suits you

Account Executive

Today, Minitab helps organizations transform operational data into meaningful business outcomes. Our solutions help organizations across industries collect, analyze, and act on data to improve performance and drive better decisions.

As a Minitab sales professional, you'll partner with organizations across a variety of industries as they transform data into better business decisions. Some customers are modernizing how they collect, manage, and analyze operational and business data, while others are leveraging advanced analytics, Statistical Process Control (SPC), process monitoring, and optimization solutions to improve quality, efficiency, and performance. Whether supporting manufacturing, operations, quality, engineering, or business leadership teams, you'll help customers solve complex challenges, drive measurable outcomes, and advance their digital transformation initiatives.

Our portfolio allows you to meet customers where they are today and expand alongside their evolving needs, creating long-term customer value and repeatable sales success.

You'll be backed by a globally respected brand with more than 50 years of experience helping organizations improve quality, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and make data-driven decisions. Today, companies around the world continue to choose Minitab because we make advanced analytics practical, scalable, and relevant to solving real operational challenges.

We're looking for a high-performing Account Executive to join our Mid-Market Sales team. Preferred Experience

Experience selling one or more of the following:

Why Minitab

At Minitab, you'll sell solutions that help customers improve quality, reduce waste, optimize processes, and accelerate digital transformation. You'll work alongside a collaborative, customer-focused team while representing one of the most respected brands in analytics and operational excellence.

Our Benefits:

HEALTH INSURANCE: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance is provided at no cost for full-time employees upon date of hire. Low co-pay pharmacy benefit and affordable family coverage plan is available. Short and Long Term Disability is fully paid by Minitab. Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Provides guidance for personal issue and information on other Work Life Matters.

LIFE INSURANCE: Group Term Life Insurance is provided at no cost for full-time employees at three times employee base salary. Minitab provides eligible employees the opportunity to purchase Voluntary Life Insurance for themselves and eligible dependents at affordable rates.

We invest in our people in fun and exciting ways, including personal development budgets and an annual all-company retreat that is focused less on work and more on human connections. We are in growth mode, and our “smart growth” approach ensures that we will continue to scale our company effectively.

Lead audience building, organic discovery, and content creation to make Intellum the name buyers know and the answer engines cite first. This senior individual contributor owns audience and content strategy and personally writes the core of it—website copy, blog posts, email nurture, and social—while driving organic growth (SEO, AEO, GEO) and running an AI-native operating model where agents handle volume. In the US, the base salary for this role is $65,000 - $70,000 with on target earnings of $145,000+. Note that we typically build 1-3 quarters of ramp time with lower goals and thus lower earnings from commissions. We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location. For all other countries, we have competitive pay bands based on market standards.

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Time Off & Family Benefits

Learning and Development

  • Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion

Inclusive, Customer-First Culture

Job Title:

Senior Partner Success Manager (Remote)

Job Description

Join our award-winning One Concentrix team as a Senior Partner Success Manager (Remote) supporting one of the world's most innovative AI-native technology companies. This role operates at the intersection of AI, customer outcomes, partner performance, and business transformation in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where speed, ownership, and execution matter.
The Senior Partner Success Manager owns a defined portfolio of partner-led customer engagements and serves as the accountable business owner for customer outcomes, engagement health, risk mitigation, adoption, and value realization across that book of business. This individual is accountable for delivery quality, customer adoption, engagement health, partner performance, customer value realization, and overall portfolio success. They are expected to independently assess situations, establish priorities, make informed business decisions, and take proactive action to improve outcomes across their portfolio.

Success in this role requires maintaining detailed visibility into every active engagement, including customer objectives, implementation progress, adoption trends, delivery risks, milestones, partner performance, blockers, and business outcomes. The Senior Partner Success Manager proactively identifies stalled or at-risk engagements, diagnoses root causes, coordinates resolution across internal and external stakeholders, and drives successful customer outcomes.

This role serves as the operational leader across partner-delivered customer engagements, balancing customer success, partner accountability, delivery excellence, AI solution adoption, and operational scalability. The ideal candidate combines strong relationship management skills with business acumen, program management discipline, customer success expertise, and technical fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models (LLMs), AI-enabled workflows, automation technologies, and enterprise software solutions. Candidates should have practical experience leveraging AI-driven business solutions and automation as part of their daily work.

ABOUT CONCENTRIX

At Concentrix, we help the world's best brands build exceptional customer experiences through innovative technology, operational excellence, and human-centered solutions. As organizations accelerate adoption of AI, automation, cloud technologies, and digital transformation initiatives, Concentrix partners with clients and strategic ecosystem partners to deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.

We are seeking a Senior Partner Success Manager to drive the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of partner-led AI solutions while ensuring customers achieve meaningful business value and long-term success.

Success in this role requires comfort operating in a highly dynamic, rapidly evolving environment where priorities shift quickly, new challenges emerge daily, and ambiguity is often present. The ideal candidate thrives in an AI-native culture, demonstrates strong initiative, embraces continuous learning, and can quickly evaluate information, make sound decisions, and drive execution without waiting for direction.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Portfolio Ownership & Customer Engagement Success

  • Own and actively manage a book of business consisting of multiple concurrent partner-led customer engagements, balancing priorities, allocating attention based on business impact, and ensuring successful outcomes across the portfolio.
  • Maintain weekly visibility into each engagement's scope, timeline, milestones, blockers, implementation status, customer health, and adoption trends.
  • Act as the accountable owner for engagement success, making judgment calls regarding prioritization, escalation, intervention strategies, and risk mitigation activities when challenges emerge.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer goals, solution objectives, operational requirements, and success criteria.
  • Coordinate seamless transitions from sales, implementation, deployment, and ongoing customer adoption phases.

Delivery Excellence & Engagement Management

  • Conduct weekly engagement reviews across the portfolio, identifying stalled, delayed, deteriorating, or at-risk engagements and implementing intervention strategies designed to restore momentum and improve customer outcomes.
  • Assess delivery plans, implementation approaches, project governance models, resource allocations, and customer readiness to identify risks before they impact outcomes.
  • Continuously prioritize resources, actions, and stakeholder engagement efforts across the portfolio based on customer impact, business value, risk exposure, and strategic importance.
  • Track engagement progression against milestones, timelines, adoption metrics, and business objectives.
  • Ensure customer deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and aligned to agreed success measures.
  • Maintain a structured operating rhythm that promotes accountability, transparency, and execution excellence.
  • Maintain and execute a self-built weekly engagement review cadence that ensures timely identification, prioritization, and resolution of delivery, adoption, and customer outcome risks across the portfolio.

Risk Management & Issue Resolution

  • Diagnose and remove barriers to successful delivery, including partner capacity constraints, implementation delays, resource challenges, scope changes, customer readiness issues, technical dependencies, adoption risks, and change management obstacles.
  • Exercise independent judgment to determine when intervention is required, when risks should be escalated, and what recovery actions are necessary to protect customer outcomes.
  • Evaluate competing priorities, incomplete information, and complex stakeholder dynamics to make sound business decisions in fast-moving situations.
  • Lead structured recovery efforts for red, escalated, or strategically important customer accounts, driving accountability across all involved stakeholders.
  • Manage escalations involving delivery quality, customer satisfaction, implementation performance, partner accountability, adoption concerns, or operational execution.
  • Bring forward clear diagnoses, accountable owners, remediation plans, and timelines for resolution rather than simply reporting status.
  • Drive issues through resolution by coordinating efforts across customers, partners, delivery teams, product teams, alliance organizations, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop recovery plans for stalled, underperforming, or at-risk engagements.

Customer Adoption, Consumption & Business Outcomes

  • Own customer adoption, utilization, consumption growth, retention indicators, and business value realization across the portfolio.
  • Identify customers showing declining adoption, stalled progress, or realization gaps and proactively design intervention plans to improve engagement health and business outcomes.
  • Monitor customer engagement metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Develop and execute action plans to improve customer adoption, operational effectiveness, and solution utilization.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to maximize customer value and expansion opportunities.
  • Track and report on metrics related to adoption growth, business outcomes, engagement completion, and customer success.
  • Demonstrate accountability for measurable outcomes tied to completed delivery, customer adoption, utilization, consumption, retention, time-to-value achievement, and realization of documented customer business outcomes.

Partner Leadership & Accountability

  • Build trusted executive-level relationships with partner practice leaders, delivery leaders, alliance executives, architects, engagement managers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Influence, challenge, and hold partners accountable for delivery performance, staffing decisions, operational execution, customer commitments, and business outcomes.
  • Hold partners accountable for engagement execution, customer outcomes, adoption targets, and delivery performance.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations and constructive challenge when partner decisions, delivery approaches, or resource allocations may negatively impact customer success.
  • Drive difficult conversations when necessary, using sound judgment and business rationale to align partners around corrective actions and improved performance.
  • Lead quarterly partner practice reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with partner alliance and delivery leaders, establishing and monitoring joint goals for completed customer engagements, customer adoption, certified practitioner capacity, customer references, repeatable offerings, and industry positioning.
  • Help partners strengthen their AI delivery capability, grow certified AI expertise, develop repeatable AI solutions, and create customer success stories that can be used to support future client engagements.
  • Steward partner co-investment and program funding requests by assessing each request against a defined customer or business outcome, recommending approval or rejection, and reconciling investment against agreed milestones and achieved results.

Practice Development & Operational Excellence

  • Create scalable operating models, governance frameworks, review methodologies, engagement health assessments, escalation processes, success plans, and delivery playbooks.
  • Transform successful engagement practices into repeatable methodologies that improve consistency, scalability, and operational performance.
  • Document and institutionalize best practices, engagement review frameworks, risk management processes, and adoption strategies.
  • Continuously improve operational effectiveness through process optimization and performance analysis.
  • Help shape the long-term Partner Success operating model for Concentrix AI-enabled service offerings.

AI, LLM & Technology Enablement

  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency using AI, LLMs, automation platforms, and emerging agentic AI technologies as a core component of daily work.
  • Regularly utilize agentic AI tools and AI-powered assistants to analyze portfolio health, identify risks, generate recommendations, uncover trends, automate workflows, and improve operational decision-making.
  • Leverage AI to increase scale, efficiency, and effectiveness while applying independent business judgment to validate recommendations and determine appropriate actions.
  • Apply AI tools to analyze customer data, identify risks, generate recommendations, streamline workflows, and improve decision-making.
  • Utilize AI-generated insights while applying sound business judgment and operational expertise.
  • Leverage customer telemetry, engagement metrics, adoption data, and operational reporting to drive actions and recommendations.
  • Stay informed on advancements in AI, LLMs, automation, SaaS platforms, and enterprise technologies impacting customers and partners.
  • Champion AI-first ways of working and identify opportunities to embed AI-driven processes into customer, partner, and operational workflows.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Professional Services, Operations, Support, Solution Design, Alliance, and Executive Leadership teams to drive alignment and successful customer outcomes.
  • Build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities, ensuring decisions are made and actions are executed in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate successful handoffs between customer acquisition, implementation, delivery, and adoption activities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor regarding customer health, partner performance, operational risks, and engagement status.
  • Present recommendations, performance updates, escalation plans, and business reviews to executive, technical, and operational audiences.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE WILL BE MEASURED BY

  • Customer adoption and utilization growth
  • Customer satisfaction and retention
  • Engagement completion within scope and timeline commitments
  • Time from engagement assignment to successful completion
  • AI solution adoption and consumption growth
  • Partner performance and relationship strength
  • At-risk engagement identification and recovery effectiveness
  • Time from an engagement being identified as stalled or at risk to successful resolution and restoration of forward progress.
  • Escalation resolution effectiveness and speed
  • Portfolio health and risk reduction
  • Customer business outcome achievement
  • Executive stakeholder trust and engagement
  • Operational scalability and process improvement
  • Adherence to and effectiveness of a structured, self-built weekly portfolio review rhythm that consistently identifies risks, drives accountability, and improves engagement outcomes.
  • Development and adoption of repeatable playbooks, methodologies, and governance frameworks
  • Effective use of AI-enabled solutions and automation to improve business outcomes

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in Partner Success, Customer Success, Delivery Management, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, Program Management, or related fields.
  • Experience owning a high-volume portfolio of concurrent customer engagements, projects, implementations, or accounts (typically 10-30 simultaneously) from initiation through successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success managing metrics tied to customer behavior and business outcomes, including adoption, utilization, consumption, retention, customer success, or expansion.
  • Demonstrated ownership of delivery outcomes, customer adoption, utilization, retention, consumption growth, time-to-value, or business value realization, with the ability to quantify impact and results achieved.
  • Experience reviewing implementation plans, delivery approaches, project scope, and customer readiness to identify execution risk and drive successful outcomes.
  • Ability to interpret statements of work (SOWs), delivery commitments, implementation plans, governance models, and documented success criteria, and identify gaps between contracted outcomes, partner execution, and actual customer experience.
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex delivery, adoption, operational, and stakeholder challenges.
  • Ability to describe, in specific and personal terms, at least one stalled or at-risk customer engagement they individually diagnosed, led, and successfully unblocked, distinct from activities primarily executed by a broader team.
  • Strong experience managing escalations and recovering at-risk customer engagements.
  • Deep understanding of customer success within usage-based, subscription-based, SaaS, AI, cloud, or technology-driven businesses.
  • Experience designing operational processes, governance models, frameworks, methodologies, playbooks, or review structures that scale across teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influence skills across customer, partner, executive, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to lead delivery reviews, evaluate implementation plans, participate in solution discussions, and engage credibly with technical stakeholders.
  • Proven hands-on experience leveraging AI, LLMs, agentic AI tools, AI-enabled workflows, automation technologies, or AI-driven business solutions as part of daily operations. Candidates should be able to demonstrate how AI has been used to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, productivity, or business results.
  • Proven hands-on experience using an LLM to build or materially improve a business workflow, analytical deliverable, operating process, or customer solution. Candidates must be able to demonstrate a real artifact or workflow, explain the problem addressed, describe how prompts or instructions were refined, identify limitations or unsupported outputs, and articulate the resulting business impact.

Preferred

  • Experience in roles with direct accountability for delivery execution, customer outcomes, implementation success, adoption, utilization, and value realization. Candidates whose background is primarily limited to relationship management, account stewardship, sales, or account growth without ownership of delivery outcomes may not be successful in this role.
  • Experience leading red account reviews, executive escalations, customer recovery programs, and structured intervention planning for at-risk accounts.
  • 5 to 8+ years supporting systems integrators, consulting firms, alliance partners, or partner-led delivery organizations.
  • Experience working with organizations such as Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, or similar consulting and integration partners.
  • Experience supporting SaaS, AI, cloud, enterprise software, professional services, or digital transformation environments.
  • Experience managing offshore, contract, or shared services delivery resources.
  • Experience administering co-investment funding, innovation initiatives, partner enablement programs, or market development funds.
  • Experience leading executive Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
  • Industry expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Retail, Manufacturing, Technology, or Public Sector markets.
  • Experience supporting enterprise and strategic customer accounts.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Gainsight, HubSpot, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent CRM and customer success platforms.
  • Must reside in the United States and have a valid U.S. residential address.

The salary for this position is $105,000 to 110,000 Annually, plus bonus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP), 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays, and paid training days.

WHY JOIN CONCENTRIX

At Concentrix, you'll help shape the future of AI-powered customer experiences while partnering with one of the world's leading AI-native organizations. You'll operate in a fast-moving environment where AI is embedded into daily workflows, decisions are made quickly, ownership is expected, and innovation is constant. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence customer success, partner performance, AI adoption, and business outcomes at scale.

Finalists should expect to participate in a live, unscripted walkthrough of an actual deliverable, workflow, or solution they personally created using an LLM. This discussion will focus on the business problem addressed, implementation approach, prompt refinement, limitations encountered, lessons learned, and measurable business impact. Prepared demonstrations or hypothetical examples are not preferred.

CAC, part of The Baldwin Group, is a leading insurance broker and advisor that provides expertise and placement capabilities across the spectrum of insurance and capital markets. Our Legal & Claims Practice Group is seeking a Claims Advocate with Financial Lines and Cyber Claims Management experience. As a Claims Advocate, you will be responsible for handling a wide range of tasks in a professional, well organized, and flexible manner, including but not limited to the following duties set forth below.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Directly handle claims from inception to resolution within the following lines of coverage: public and private Directors and Officers Liability, Errors and Omissions, Employment Practices Liability, Cyber and Technology Errors and Omissions, Fiduciary Liability, Crime, and Kidnap and Ransom.
  • Timely and accurately report new claims and circumstances while proactively identifying potential coverage issues that may impact resolution.
  • Obtain insurer consent for counsel retention and settlements.
  • Conduct analysis of coverage letters from insurers.
  • Facilitate the distribution of insurer coverage position(s) and status update(s) to insurers.
  • Schedule and moderate client meetings and conference calls with insurers.
  • Maintain invoice trackers and reconcile invoices against client policy retention.
  • Facilitate insurer reimbursement payments to clients.
  • Maintain up-to-date electronic claim files in the LCP shared drive.
  • Review loss runs and obtain status updates on all matters to ensure timely and accurate file maintenance.
  • Escalate claim and coverage issues on a timely basis to CAC leadership.
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with clients and insurer claim representatives.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required (paralegal certification is beneficial)
  • 2-5 years of Financial Lines/Cyber/D&O claims management experience required
  • Strong multitasking and time management skills
  • Strong communication and relationship management skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to engage with and present confidently to clients both external and internal
  • Ability to identify client needs and provide solutions to address those needs
  • Ability to set realistic client expectations and deliver in a time-sensitive environment
  • Strong expertise in Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • High level of professionalism and confidentiality.

Salary: $100-120k salary range plus bonus opportunity and benefits. This information reflects the anticipated range for this position. Actual salary may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience, and other relevant factors.

We provide career advancement opportunities from within the organization across multiple locations in the US, South America, and India.

Role: Product Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 5+ Years

About the Role

We are looking for a thoughtful, outcome-focused Product Manager to take ownership of the product development lifecycle—from shaping ideas with stakeholders to defining requirements, prioritizing the roadmap, and partnering with engineering and design teams to deliver meaningful product improvements.

In this role, you'll work closely with engineering, design, account teams, and business stakeholders to understand customer needs, translate complex business requirements into clear product solutions, and ensure we're building products that deliver measurable business and user value.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambiguous environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and takes ownership from concept through launch and beyond.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, customers, and account teams to gather feature requests and understand business needs.
  • Translate high-level requirements into clear product specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
  • Own and continuously prioritize the product backlog, roadmap, and release plans based on business impact, customer needs, and technical considerations.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Lead customer and stakeholder discussions, document requirements, and ensure timely follow-up on action items.
  • Serve as the primary product point of contact for account teams and business stakeholders, providing clarity on priorities, trade-offs, dependencies, and timelines.
  • Define lightweight product and delivery processes that improve team efficiency and help ensure consistent execution.
  • Use customer feedback, product data, analytics, and business objectives to inform product decisions.
  • Establish measurable success criteria and key metrics before launching features and evaluate performance after launch.
  • Identify and resolve open questions, risks, and cross-functional dependencies before they become blockers for engineering.
  • Create and maintain internal product documentation, release notes, and other product-related materials as needed.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure successful product launches and adoption.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably with experience building and managing SaaS products.
  • Proven experience owning products or features throughout the end-to-end product development lifecycle.
  • Strong experience working collaboratively with engineering, design, business stakeholders, and customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear product requirements, specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to make informed product decisions.
  • Comfortable working with SQL and independently querying data to investigate questions, validate assumptions, and support product decisions.
  • Experience reasoning through complex business rules, workflows, and system states, including understanding how changes to business rules may impact existing data and functionality.
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into simple, well-scoped, actionable product solutions.
  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your day-to-day product workflow, with the judgment to validate and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate and maintain working-hour overlap with teams operating in Eastern Time (ET).

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience working in healthcare, logistics, benefits administration, claims, EDI billing, or other regulated or operationally complex industries.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and lightweight project management practices.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical and functional product requirements.
  • Experience working directly with customers and business stakeholders to identify problems and define solutions.
  • Experience launching an LLM/AI-powered product or feature to real users.
  • Experience with benefits administration, healthcare claims processing, or EDI/X12 billing workflows.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • Engineering teams have clear, well-defined requirements and are able to move quickly without unnecessary ambiguity.
  • Product priorities are aligned with customer needs and measurable business outcomes.
  • Stakeholders have visibility into priorities, trade-offs, dependencies, and timelines.
  • Features launch with clearly defined success criteria and are evaluated using meaningful data.
  • Customer and user feedback consistently influences product decisions.
  • Product processes remain lightweight, practical, and focused on enabling the team to deliver better outcomes.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in supporting our team with meaningful benefits that promote well-being, flexibility, and professional growth.

Our benefits include:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance with employer contributions
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
  • Paid Holidays
  • A driven, impact-focused culture where autonomy, ownership, and collaboration are highly valued
