About Landing

We are a nationwide hospitality platform where fully-furnished apartments meet hotel quality and consistency. Guests access a curated selection of thousands of high-quality apartments available for any length of stay in hundreds of cities nationwide.

By blending the best of hospitality and everyday comfort, every unit is designed with all the amenities of home backed by 24/7 local support. For a week-long getaway or an extended adventure, We deliver a familiar and frictionless guest experience that’s perfect for any travel occasion, for work or pleasure.

For property owners, We offer a fast path to new revenue and higher occupancy in just weeks by tapping into our nationwide demand for furnished, hospitality-grade housing. We provide a turnkey solution that covers the entire unit experience, from furnishings to guest turnover and everything in between, with zero operational lift from partners. We handle it all so partners can unlock value faster.

The Role

We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic pricing leader to own revenue optimization across our rapidly growing portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of data science, strategy, and execution, responsible for driving measurable impact on occupancy, revenue, and profitability.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Operations to shape pricing decisions at the home, market, and network level.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own pricing and revenue optimization strategy for all homes, balancing occupancy, rate, and contribution profit.
  • Enhance and scale our machine learning–driven pricing model.
  • Develop and deploy dynamic pricing logic for lifecycle stages (launch vs. mature), stay lengths, and distribution channels.
  • Build and maintain pricing and performance dashboards using Python, SQL, and Looker.
  • Run elasticity tests, scenario modeling, and pacing analysis to guide decisions with a test-and-learn mindset.
  • Integrate external data sources (AirDNA, CoStar) into pricing strategies.
  • Partner with Marketing on channel mix and ROAS tradeoffs, ensuring OTA vs. direct pricing alignment.
  • Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership to influence revenue and investment decisions.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7–10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, or data analytics (ideally in hospitality, travel, or other perishable-inventory industries).
  • Hands-on fluency with revenue management systems and multi-property pricing strategies.
  • Experience building or managing algorithmic or ML-based pricing systems.
  • Deep understanding of price elasticity, occupancy forecasting, and RevPAR optimization.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to distill complex analyses for executives.
  • High bias for action and comfort operating in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with OTA pricing or channel management (Airbnb, Expedia, Booking.com).
  • Familiarity with CoStar or AirDNA datasets.
  • Strong Python skills (pandas, statsmodels, etc.) for building revenue analytics and modeling.
  • Ability to design and interpret statistical tests to balance revenue and conversion outcomes.
  • Experience in high-growth startups or tech-enabled real estate.

What we offer

  • Opportunities for upward mobility — we want you to grow with us

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.
Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?We’re looking for a CRM Data Analyst who can turn customer, campaign, and transactional data into clear commercial insights. You’ll sit at the intersection of CRM, loyalty, data, and restaurant operations, helping teams understand what is driving customer engagement, retention, and value.

You’ll be comfortable working independently with large datasets, asking the right questions of the data, and turning open-ended analytical briefs into practical recommendations that influence business decisions.

What Will You Do?

  • Analyse CRM and campaign data across Braze to measure acquisition, engagement, retention, LTV, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Interrogate customer and transactional data to identify behavioural trends, purchase patterns, and opportunities.
  • Conduct restaurant-level analysis across order frequency, average basket value, transactions, and different store formats.
  • Compare performance across Equity vs. Franchise and Drive-Thru vs. Non-Drive-Thru locations.
  • Build benchmarks and identify underperforming restaurants, customer segments, campaigns, and operational areas.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable commercial recommendations for CRM, Loyalty, and Restaurant Operations teams.
  • Build intuitive Power BI dashboards and reporting that make insights easy for stakeholders to understand and act on.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics, Data Engineering, CRM, Loyalty, and Operations teams to access and validate relevant datasets.
  • Investigate open-ended business questions, structure the analysis, and take findings from brief to action.
  • Contribute to a broader data-driven approach to customer engagement, loyalty, and restaurant performance.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Strong experience as a Data Analyst, CRM Analyst, Customer Analyst, or similar analytical role, ideally within CRM, loyalty, retail, QSR, or consumer businesses.
  • Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently query, join, clean, and analyse large datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Strong Power BI or BI tooling experience, with the ability to build clear dashboards and reporting.
  • Solid understanding of CRM and loyalty analytics, including customer lifecycle, segmentation, retention, LTV, campaign performance, and engagement metrics.

At Oviva, we’re on a mission to make sustainable, personalized, clinically effective care accessible to everyone.

We’ve already supported over one million people across the UK, Switzerland, Germany, and Poland – and we’re just getting started. Every conversation, coaching session, and line of code brings us closer to a healthier future. Join us, and be part of the team making that future possible.

As an Obesity Care Co-ordinator you have experience in a healthcare setting and will be an integral part of our Tier 3 Weight Management team, working in close partnership with the Consultant Endocrinologist to provide coordinated, patient-facing support.

You will work directly alongside the Consultant Endocrinologist, taking ownership of appointment management, patient scheduling, and administrative coordination to ensure the Consultant's caseload runs smoothly and efficiently

Responsibilities

  • Delivering high quality specialist care coordination to patients enrolled in our Tier 3 Weight Management programme, under the clinical oversight of the Consultant Endocrinologist

  • Ensure key treatment and outcome data is kept up to date for treatment and audit purposes
  • Work with other team members to develop and refine efficient patient systems and workflows
  • Work closely with the Patient and Clinical Services teams to ensure a smooth patient journey from onboarding to discharge
  • Act as a point of contact for all administrative support within the Consultant Endocrinologist's team

Requirements

Essential:
  • Experience in a healthcare setting, ideally within patient services, specialist clinics, or clinical administration
  • Confidence working alongside senior clinicians, including consultants, in a fast-paced specialist setting
  • Strong ability to handle sensitive data and a great attention to detail
  • Good understanding of Information Governance procedures to ensure the security of patient data
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Competent user of IT equipment and essential software (email, word processing, data entry and interpretation)

  • Ability to thrive in challenging, fast-paced situations
  • Highly organised with the ability to work autonomously
  • Ability to prioritise your workload based on business needs
  • Passion for providing digital treatment & support
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills with the ability to manage complex patient cases
Desirable:
  • Previous EMIS experience
  • Experience of managing a large patient caseload in a specialist or secondary care setting

Benefits

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in revolutionizing healthcare
  • Exciting and rewarding role in the high-growth environment
  • Training and development opportunities, with a personal learning allowance
  • We embrace flexibility & remote working
  • We provide a home working allowance to enable you to set up your workspace in a way which suits you

Account Executive

Today, Minitab helps organizations transform operational data into meaningful business outcomes. Our solutions help organizations across industries collect, analyze, and act on data to improve performance and drive better decisions.

As a Minitab sales professional, you'll partner with organizations across a variety of industries as they transform data into better business decisions. Some customers are modernizing how they collect, manage, and analyze operational and business data, while others are leveraging advanced analytics, Statistical Process Control (SPC), process monitoring, and optimization solutions to improve quality, efficiency, and performance. Whether supporting manufacturing, operations, quality, engineering, or business leadership teams, you'll help customers solve complex challenges, drive measurable outcomes, and advance their digital transformation initiatives.

Our portfolio allows you to meet customers where they are today and expand alongside their evolving needs, creating long-term customer value and repeatable sales success.

You'll be backed by a globally respected brand with more than 50 years of experience helping organizations improve quality, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and make data-driven decisions. Today, companies around the world continue to choose Minitab because we make advanced analytics practical, scalable, and relevant to solving real operational challenges.

We're looking for a high-performing Account Executive to join our Mid-Market Sales team. This is an opportunity for a consultative sales professional with experience selling SaaS, enterprise software, manufacturing software, industrial software, analytics, or business applications into mid-market organizations.

What You'll Do

Experience selling one or more of the following:

Why Minitab

At Minitab, you'll sell solutions that help customers improve quality, reduce waste, optimize processes, and accelerate digital transformation. You'll work alongside a collaborative, customer-focused team while representing one of the most respected brands in analytics and operational excellence.

Our Benefits:

HEALTH INSURANCE: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance is provided at no cost for full-time employees upon date of hire. Low co-pay pharmacy benefit and affordable family coverage plan is available. Short and Long Term Disability is fully paid by Minitab. Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Provides guidance for personal issue and information on other Work Life Matters.

LIFE INSURANCE: Group Term Life Insurance is provided at no cost for full-time employees at three times employee base salary. Minitab provides eligible employees the opportunity to purchase Voluntary Life Insurance for themselves and eligible dependents at affordable rates.

We invest in our people in fun and exciting ways, including personal development budgets and an annual all-company retreat that is focused less on work and more on human connections. We are in growth mode, and our “smart growth” approach ensures that we will continue to scale our company effectively.

Lead audience building, organic discovery, and content creation to make Intellum the name buyers know and the answer engines cite first. This senior individual contributor owns audience and content strategy and personally writes the core of it—website copy, blog posts, email nurture, and social—while driving organic growth (SEO, AEO, GEO) and running an AI-native operating model where agents handle volume. In the US, the base salary for this role is $65,000 - $70,000 with on target earnings of $145,000+. Note that we typically build 1-3 quarters of ramp time with lower goals and thus lower earnings from commissions. We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location. For all other countries, we have competitive pay bands based on market standards.

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Time Off & Family Benefits

  • 4+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days

Learning and Development

  • Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion
  • Bi-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training

Inclusive, Customer-First Culture

  • Agile, founder-led company focused on collaboration and innovation

Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.-based employees. Support is provided for employees in other locations, in compliance with local laws and regulations.

Please note: For detailed information regarding our GDPR and/or CCPA compliance policies, including how we handle personal data and privacy rights, kindly refer to the email correspondence accompanying this application.

Muck Rack considers applicants for all positions on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs, and without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, alienage or citizenship status, ancestry, marital status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, familial status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Job Title:

Senior Partner Success Manager (Remote)

Job Description

Join our award-winning One Concentrix team as a Senior Partner Success Manager (Remote) supporting one of the world's most innovative AI-native technology companies. This role operates at the intersection of AI, customer outcomes, partner performance, and business transformation in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where speed, ownership, and execution matter.
The Senior Partner Success Manager owns a defined portfolio of partner-led customer engagements and serves as the accountable business owner for customer outcomes, engagement health, risk mitigation, adoption, and value realization across that book of business. This individual is accountable for delivery quality, customer adoption, engagement health, partner performance, customer value realization, and overall portfolio success. They are expected to independently assess situations, establish priorities, make informed business decisions, and take proactive action to improve outcomes across their portfolio.

Success in this role requires maintaining detailed visibility into every active engagement, including customer objectives, implementation progress, adoption trends, delivery risks, milestones, partner performance, blockers, and business outcomes. The Senior Partner Success Manager proactively identifies stalled or at-risk engagements, diagnoses root causes, coordinates resolution across internal and external stakeholders, and drives successful customer outcomes.

This role serves as the operational leader across partner-delivered customer engagements, balancing customer success, partner accountability, delivery excellence, AI solution adoption, and operational scalability. The ideal candidate combines strong relationship management skills with business acumen, program management discipline, customer success expertise, and technical fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models (LLMs), AI-enabled workflows, automation technologies, and enterprise software solutions. Candidates should have practical experience leveraging AI-driven business solutions and automation as part of their daily work.

ABOUT CONCENTRIX

At Concentrix, we help the world's best brands build exceptional customer experiences through innovative technology, operational excellence, and human-centered solutions. As organizations accelerate adoption of AI, automation, cloud technologies, and digital transformation initiatives, Concentrix partners with clients and strategic ecosystem partners to deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.

We are seeking a Senior Partner Success Manager to drive the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of partner-led AI solutions while ensuring customers achieve meaningful business value and long-term success.

Success in this role requires comfort operating in a highly dynamic, rapidly evolving environment where priorities shift quickly, new challenges emerge daily, and ambiguity is often present. The ideal candidate thrives in an AI-native culture, demonstrates strong initiative, embraces continuous learning, and can quickly evaluate information, make sound decisions, and drive execution without waiting for direction.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Portfolio Ownership & Customer Engagement Success

  • Own and actively manage a book of business consisting of multiple concurrent partner-led customer engagements, balancing priorities, allocating attention based on business impact, and ensuring successful outcomes across the portfolio.
  • Maintain weekly visibility into each engagement's scope, timeline, milestones, blockers, implementation status, customer health, and adoption trends.
  • Act as the accountable owner for engagement success, making judgment calls regarding prioritization, escalation, intervention strategies, and risk mitigation activities when challenges emerge.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer goals, solution objectives, operational requirements, and success criteria.
  • Coordinate seamless transitions from sales, implementation, deployment, and ongoing customer adoption phases.

Delivery Excellence & Engagement Management

  • Conduct weekly engagement reviews across the portfolio, identifying stalled, delayed, deteriorating, or at-risk engagements and implementing intervention strategies designed to restore momentum and improve customer outcomes.
  • Assess delivery plans, implementation approaches, project governance models, resource allocations, and customer readiness to identify risks before they impact outcomes.
  • Continuously prioritize resources, actions, and stakeholder engagement efforts across the portfolio based on customer impact, business value, risk exposure, and strategic importance.
  • Track engagement progression against milestones, timelines, adoption metrics, and business objectives.
  • Ensure customer deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and aligned to agreed success measures.
  • Maintain a structured operating rhythm that promotes accountability, transparency, and execution excellence.
  • Maintain and execute a self-built weekly engagement review cadence that ensures timely identification, prioritization, and resolution of delivery, adoption, and customer outcome risks across the portfolio.

Risk Management & Issue Resolution

  • Diagnose and remove barriers to successful delivery, including partner capacity constraints, implementation delays, resource challenges, scope changes, customer readiness issues, technical dependencies, adoption risks, and change management obstacles.
  • Exercise independent judgment to determine when intervention is required, when risks should be escalated, and what recovery actions are necessary to protect customer outcomes.
  • Evaluate competing priorities, incomplete information, and complex stakeholder dynamics to make sound business decisions in fast-moving situations.
  • Lead structured recovery efforts for red, escalated, or strategically important customer accounts, driving accountability across all involved stakeholders.
  • Manage escalations involving delivery quality, customer satisfaction, implementation performance, partner accountability, adoption concerns, or operational execution.
  • Bring forward clear diagnoses, accountable owners, remediation plans, and timelines for resolution rather than simply reporting status.
  • Drive issues through resolution by coordinating efforts across customers, partners, delivery teams, product teams, alliance organizations, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop recovery plans for stalled, underperforming, or at-risk engagements.

Customer Adoption, Consumption & Business Outcomes

  • Own customer adoption, utilization, consumption growth, retention indicators, and business value realization across the portfolio.
  • Identify customers showing declining adoption, stalled progress, or realization gaps and proactively design intervention plans to improve engagement health and business outcomes.
  • Monitor customer engagement metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Develop and execute action plans to improve customer adoption, operational effectiveness, and solution utilization.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to maximize customer value and expansion opportunities.
  • Track and report on metrics related to adoption growth, business outcomes, engagement completion, and customer success.
  • Demonstrate accountability for measurable outcomes tied to completed delivery, customer adoption, utilization, consumption, retention, time-to-value achievement, and realization of documented customer business outcomes.

Partner Leadership & Accountability

  • Build trusted executive-level relationships with partner practice leaders, delivery leaders, alliance executives, architects, engagement managers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Influence, challenge, and hold partners accountable for delivery performance, staffing decisions, operational execution, customer commitments, and business outcomes.
  • Hold partners accountable for engagement execution, customer outcomes, adoption targets, and delivery performance.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations and constructive challenge when partner decisions, delivery approaches, or resource allocations may negatively impact customer success.
  • Drive difficult conversations when necessary, using sound judgment and business rationale to align partners around corrective actions and improved performance.
  • Lead quarterly partner practice reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with partner alliance and delivery leaders, establishing and monitoring joint goals for completed customer engagements, customer adoption, certified practitioner capacity, customer references, repeatable offerings, and industry positioning.
  • Help partners strengthen their AI delivery capability, grow certified AI expertise, develop repeatable AI solutions, and create customer success stories that can be used to support future client engagements.
  • Steward partner co-investment and program funding requests by assessing each request against a defined customer or business outcome, recommending approval or rejection, and reconciling investment against agreed milestones and achieved results.

Practice Development & Operational Excellence

  • Create scalable operating models, governance frameworks, review methodologies, engagement health assessments, escalation processes, success plans, and delivery playbooks.
  • Transform successful engagement practices into repeatable methodologies that improve consistency, scalability, and operational performance.
  • Document and institutionalize best practices, engagement review frameworks, risk management processes, and adoption strategies.
  • Continuously improve operational effectiveness through process optimization and performance analysis.
  • Help shape the long-term Partner Success operating model for Concentrix AI-enabled service offerings.

AI, LLM & Technology Enablement

  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency using AI, LLMs, automation platforms, and emerging agentic AI technologies as a core component of daily work.
  • Regularly utilize agentic AI tools and AI-powered assistants to analyze portfolio health, identify risks, generate recommendations, uncover trends, automate workflows, and improve operational decision-making.
  • Leverage AI to increase scale, efficiency, and effectiveness while applying independent business judgment to validate recommendations and determine appropriate actions.
  • Apply AI tools to analyze customer data, identify risks, generate recommendations, streamline workflows, and improve decision-making.
  • Utilize AI-generated insights while applying sound business judgment and operational expertise.
  • Leverage customer telemetry, engagement metrics, adoption data, and operational reporting to drive actions and recommendations.
  • Stay informed on advancements in AI, LLMs, automation, SaaS platforms, and enterprise technologies impacting customers and partners.
  • Champion AI-first ways of working and identify opportunities to embed AI-driven processes into customer, partner, and operational workflows.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Professional Services, Operations, Support, Solution Design, Alliance, and Executive Leadership teams to drive alignment and successful customer outcomes.
  • Build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities, ensuring decisions are made and actions are executed in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate successful handoffs between customer acquisition, implementation, delivery, and adoption activities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor regarding customer health, partner performance, operational risks, and engagement status.
  • Present recommendations, performance updates, escalation plans, and business reviews to executive, technical, and operational audiences.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE WILL BE MEASURED BY

  • Customer adoption and utilization growth
  • Customer satisfaction and retention
  • Engagement completion within scope and timeline commitments
  • Time from engagement assignment to successful completion
  • AI solution adoption and consumption growth
  • Partner performance and relationship strength
  • At-risk engagement identification and recovery effectiveness
  • Time from an engagement being identified as stalled or at risk to successful resolution and restoration of forward progress.
  • Escalation resolution effectiveness and speed
  • Portfolio health and risk reduction
  • Customer business outcome achievement
  • Executive stakeholder trust and engagement
  • Operational scalability and process improvement
  • Adherence to and effectiveness of a structured, self-built weekly portfolio review rhythm that consistently identifies risks, drives accountability, and improves engagement outcomes.
  • Development and adoption of repeatable playbooks, methodologies, and governance frameworks
  • Effective use of AI-enabled solutions and automation to improve business outcomes

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in Partner Success, Customer Success, Delivery Management, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, Program Management, or related fields.
  • Experience owning a high-volume portfolio of concurrent customer engagements, projects, implementations, or accounts (typically 10-30 simultaneously) from initiation through successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success managing metrics tied to customer behavior and business outcomes, including adoption, utilization, consumption, retention, customer success, or expansion.
  • Demonstrated ownership of delivery outcomes, customer adoption, utilization, retention, consumption growth, time-to-value, or business value realization, with the ability to quantify impact and results achieved.
  • Experience reviewing implementation plans, delivery approaches, project scope, and customer readiness to identify execution risk and drive successful outcomes.
  • Ability to interpret statements of work (SOWs), delivery commitments, implementation plans, governance models, and documented success criteria, and identify gaps between contracted outcomes, partner execution, and actual customer experience.
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex delivery, adoption, operational, and stakeholder challenges.
  • Ability to describe, in specific and personal terms, at least one stalled or at-risk customer engagement they individually diagnosed, led, and successfully unblocked, distinct from activities primarily executed by a broader team.
  • Strong experience managing escalations and recovering at-risk customer engagements.
  • Deep understanding of customer success within usage-based, subscription-based, SaaS, AI, cloud, or technology-driven businesses.
  • Experience designing operational processes, governance models, frameworks, methodologies, playbooks, or review structures that scale across teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influence skills across customer, partner, executive, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to lead delivery reviews, evaluate implementation plans, participate in solution discussions, and engage credibly with technical stakeholders.
  • Proven hands-on experience leveraging AI, LLMs, agentic AI tools, AI-enabled workflows, automation technologies, or AI-driven business solutions as part of daily operations. Candidates should be able to demonstrate how AI has been used to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, productivity, or business results.
  • Proven hands-on experience using an LLM to build or materially improve a business workflow, analytical deliverable, operating process, or customer solution. Candidates must be able to demonstrate a real artifact or workflow, explain the problem addressed, describe how prompts or instructions were refined, identify limitations or unsupported outputs, and articulate the resulting business impact.

Preferred

  • Experience in roles with direct accountability for delivery execution, customer outcomes, implementation success, adoption, utilization, and value realization. Candidates whose background is primarily limited to relationship management, account stewardship, sales, or account growth without ownership of delivery outcomes may not be successful in this role.
  • Experience leading red account reviews, executive escalations, customer recovery programs, and structured intervention planning for at-risk accounts.
  • 5 to 8+ years supporting systems integrators, consulting firms, alliance partners, or partner-led delivery organizations.
  • Experience working with organizations such as Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, or similar consulting and integration partners.
  • Experience supporting SaaS, AI, cloud, enterprise software, professional services, or digital transformation environments.
  • Experience managing offshore, contract, or shared services delivery resources.
  • Experience administering co-investment funding, innovation initiatives, partner enablement programs, or market development funds.
  • Experience leading executive Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
  • Industry expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Retail, Manufacturing, Technology, or Public Sector markets.
  • Experience supporting enterprise and strategic customer accounts.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Gainsight, HubSpot, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent CRM and customer success platforms.
  • Must reside in the United States and have a valid U.S. residential address.

The salary for this position is $105,000 to 110,000 Annually, plus bonus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP), 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays, and paid training days.

WHY JOIN CONCENTRIX

At Concentrix, you'll help shape the future of AI-powered customer experiences while partnering with one of the world's leading AI-native organizations. You'll operate in a fast-moving environment where AI is embedded into daily workflows, decisions are made quickly, ownership is expected, and innovation is constant. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence customer success, partner performance, AI adoption, and business outcomes at scale.

Finalists should expect to participate in a live, unscripted walkthrough of an actual deliverable, workflow, or solution they personally created using an LLM. This discussion will focus on the business problem addressed, implementation approach, prompt refinement, limitations encountered, lessons learned, and measurable business impact. Prepared demonstrations or hypothetical examples are not preferred.

Our high-performance culture is what allows us to drive sustained growth. Stronger together, we promote an environment where individuals can thrive.

Member Success Manager | Air Elite Network

Location: Webster, TX (Remote)

Salary: $63,000 - $75,000 DOE plus bonus opportunity

Help Shape the Experience of a Global Aviation Network

World Fuel is seeking a relationship-focused Network Experience Specialist to support the Air Elite Network, one of the aviation industry's premier FBO networks.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted partner to Air Elite members, helping them maximize the value of their membership while delivering an exceptional member experience. You'll build strong relationships, support member engagement initiatives, coordinate communications, and work closely with internal teams to enhance the overall success of the network.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working with customers, building lasting relationships, solving problems, and creating positive experiences. If you're highly organized, proactive, and passionate about helping customers succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Build Strong Member Relationships

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for Air Elite members.
  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships with member organizations.
  • Deliver exceptional service through proactive communication and responsive support.
  • Partner with members to understand their needs and help them maximize the benefits of the Air Elite Network.

Drive Member Engagement

  • Support onboarding and training for new members.
  • Coordinate member communications, program updates, and engagement initiatives.
  • Help strengthen member satisfaction, participation, and retention.
  • Support programs and activities that enhance the overall member experience.

Support Network Growth and Success

  • Collaborate with Commercial, Operations, Marketing, and Legal teams to support member objectives.
  • Monitor member feedback and identify opportunities to enhance network value.
  • Help ensure consistent execution of Air Elite programs and standards.
  • Track member activity and support strategic initiatives that drive long-term growth.

Program Administration

  • Maintain accurate member records and documentation.
  • Support membership agreements, renewals, and related processes.
  • Assist with planning and coordination of member events, meetings, and recognition programs.
  • Help ensure compliance with network standards and program requirements.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, customer service, relationship management, hospitality, communications, or a related field.
  • Salesforce experience required.
  • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Aviation industry experience.
  • Experience supporting customer programs, memberships, loyalty programs, or account management.
  • Experience working with CRM systems.
  • Knowledge of customer engagement and retention strategies.
  • Social media or communications experience.

What Makes You Successful

You are someone who:

  • Enjoys building meaningful customer relationships.
  • Communicates professionally and confidently.
  • Takes initiative and follows through on commitments.
  • Thrives in a collaborative environment.
  • Is highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Finds satisfaction in helping customers and partners succeed.

Why Join World Fuel?

  • Work with one of the industry's most respected aviation networks.
  • Build relationships with aviation professionals across the globe.
  • Make a direct impact on member satisfaction and network growth.
  • Gain exposure to customer experience, business operations, marketing, and aviation.
  • Join a collaborative and supportive team that values innovation, service excellence, and professional growth.

#WFS

raw.title: Business Analyst
raw.excerpt: Who We AreClaritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.

This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.

The Position

Our Ascend® platform represents the next generation of our delivery capability — a standardized, scalable implementation model that enables faster, higher-quality client onboarding across our specialty pharmacy data ecosystem.

The Business Analyst is the primary technical executor of the Ascend platform configuration. The top expectation of this role is the ability to lead and manage spec negotiations with data partners — ensuring that inbound and outbound data file specifications are aligned with the Ascend data model before configuration work begins. This requires both deep technical fluency in specialty pharmacy data structures and the communication skills to drive data partners toward compliant, complete specifications without compromising go-live timelines.

Working from the Configuration Blueprint produced by the Delivery Director, the BA owns all data mapping, platform configuration, and internal quality assurance before any client-facing testing begins. The BA operates as a critical resource within the Ascend implementation team — interfacing with Engagement Managers, Delivery Directors, and Customer Engineering — and is expected to communicate capacity constraints proactively given the demands of a multi-client portfolio.

As a member of the Delivery and Operations team, the BA is responsible for executing implementation configuration work, conducting rigorous internal QA, and ensuring that nothing advances to UAT without sign-off. The BA is the standard-vs-custom decision support layer for data: identifying when client requests require escalation to Product or Customer Engineering versus when they can be addressed within the standard data model. Role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements.

Key Accountabilities

Data Partner Spec Negotiation ★ Primary Accountability

  • Lead spec negotiations with specialty pharmacy and other data partners to ensure inbound and outbound file specifications are fully aligned with the Ascend data model before configuration begins — this is the single most critical function of the role
  • Review partner-submitted data specifications for completeness, field-level accuracy, and model alignment; document gaps and drive resolution directly with the data partner
  • Negotiate field mappings, list-of-values (LOVs), file formats, and delivery cadences with data partners, escalating to the Engagement Manager only when partner alignment cannot be achieved at the working level
  • Validate test files against finalized specifications and flag discrepancies before data enters the pipeline; maintain a clear record of spec versions and sign-off status across all active partners
  • Translate data partner constraints into actionable decisions for the implementation team — identifying what can be resolved through configuration, what requires a spec exception, and what must route to Customer Engineering

Platform Configuration & Data Mapping

  • Own all platform configuration work: data mapping, configuration tooling, business logic implementation, and front-end reporting setup — all driven by the Configuration Blueprint received from the Delivery Director
  • Review data specifications produced in collaboration with the Engagement Manager; proactively flag data model mismatches or gaps prior to configuration work beginning
  • Load data into the pipeline using configuration tooling once specifications are finalized and signed off by relevant stakeholders
  • Collaborate with Customer Engineering on the handoff of data mapping for standard data model onboarding; provide CE with the context needed for custom build workstreams

Internal QA & Quality Standards

  • Conduct internal QA testing of all configuration work prior to partner or client-facing testing — nothing advances to UAT without BA sign-off
  • Track and resolve defects identified during internal QA and UAT for all configuration-related issues
  • Perform quality control procedures to assure configurations and data quality meet acceptance criteria prior to go-live
  • Develop and maintain QA documentation, test case frameworks, and checklists that support repeatable, auditable testing across implementations

Escalation & Non-Standard Request Routing

  • Identify whether client requests fall within the standard Ascend data model, require configuration adjustment, or require escalation — to Product for roadmap consideration or to Customer Engineering for custom build
  • Document and route non-standard requests with clear business need descriptions and technical context so that Product and CE can act without re-scoping
  • Conduct change impact analysis to assess how updates or non-standard requests may affect system performance and configuration decisions

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Consult with Engagement Managers on data partner specs, testing timelines, and UAT scheduling to ensure internal readiness gates are met
  • Coordinate with Delivery Director on receipt and interpretation of the Configuration Blueprint — the primary work input for each implementation
  • Report blockers, capacity constraints, and escalations to the Engagement Manager proactively; given a typical 1-BA-to-many implementations ratio, early communication of bandwidth risks is a core accountability
  • Support the Delivery Director and Customer Success with UAT business validation for configuration-related questions

Process, Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Facilitate schema normalization of system databases; maintain data dictionaries and file inventories across customer applications
  • Consults with cross-functional teams to document business requirements, operating procedures, issue resolution processes, and platform configurations that enable efficient implementation
  • Develop and maintain an operating playbook that details best practices for configuration sequencing, data partner onboarding, and documentation requirements
  • Write clear, detailed procedures for internal training and be able to train other Business Analysts as the team scales
  • Support creation and ongoing maintenance of standard UAT test script templates for core Ascend use cases in partnership with the Delivery Director

Who You Are

Skills & Knowledge:

  • Demonstrated ability to lead data partner spec negotiations — driving alignment on file specifications, field mappings, and LOVs across multiple external partners simultaneously
  • Excellent written and oral communication — able to document complex data relationships clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to prioritize, organize, and execute multiple tasks simultaneously with rigorous attention to detail across a high-volume implementation portfolio
  • A creative approach to operational problem solving and a relentless passion for quality
  • Deep knowledge of data management in specialty biotech and/or operations in reimbursement call centers or specialty pharmacies
  • Familiarity with healthcare data sources — transactional, clinical, and behavioral — including specialty pharmacy data file types (patient demographics, dispense, status, inventory)
  • Understanding of standard implementation lifecycle frameworks: UAT facilitation, defect triage, QA gating, and go-live readiness
  • Ability to exercise judgment within broadly defined practices and policies when selecting methods and techniques for configuration decisions

Education & Experience

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree from a 4-year university
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in an operations role at a biopharmaceutical manufacturer, reimbursement call center, specialty pharmacy, or data management company
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other analytic tools — specifically data comparison, conditional formulas, data summary, and conversion
  • Functional knowledge of Microsoft Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Background and experience with the Business Analysis toolkit including systems development lifecycles, problem solving and root cause analysis methods, and the ability to document business process models
  • Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables across multiple concurrent implementations or client programs

Preferred:

  • Experience with specialty pharmacy data file specifications, SFTP workflows, and data onboarding processes
  • Academic training in public health, business administration, and/or operations research
  • Case management experience in a reimbursement call center or specialty pharmacy
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Smartsheet, JIRA, or Confluence
  • Familiarity with Google Docs, workflow diagram tools, web-based software systems, and relational databases
  • Experience working within a structured RACI model or implementation team framework

Join Us

We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.

We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.

In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $115,000 to $125,000 and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.

Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!

At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:

•All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.

• We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.

• We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.

• Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.

Claritas Rx is committed to transparency, integrity, and a safe hiring experience for every candidate. Learn more

raw.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Partnerships Manager

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

SALARY

DLB recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

JOB SUMMARY

The Partnerships Manager provides operational leadership for DLB's external delivery partnerships, including subconsultant relationships, outsourced engineering resources, and offshore teams supporting the Design Department. This role is responsible for ensuring DLB has access to qualified, scalable external resources to support project delivery, business growth, and changing capacity demands.

Reporting to the Associate Director, Strategy & Growth, the Partnerships Manager works collaboratively with Project Managers, Program Managers, technical leaders, Contracts, Finance, and external partners to forecast resource needs, engage appropriate partners, develop and issue requests for proposals and fee requests, coordinate commercial requirements, and support successful integration of external resources into DLB project teams.

This is NOT a Business Development role; this person will manage existing partnerships internally and will support the Associate Director of Partnerships in new partnership development. The Partnerships Manager serves as a primary relationship and operational owner for DLB's subconsultant and offshore partner network, developing scalable processes that improve the speed, quality, consistency, and effectiveness of external capacity deployment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Subconsultant Partnerships and Management (30%)

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with DLB's network of engineering, design, architecture, and specialty subconsultant partners.
  • Serve as the primary Design Department counterpart to the Contracts team for subconsultant engagement and administration.
  • Coordinate with Project Managers, Program Managers, and technical leaders to understand project scope, schedule, and capacity requirements.
  • Develop, issue, and manage requests for proposals, fee requests, and other commercial solicitations to external partners.
  • Evaluate subconsultant proposals for scope alignment, pricing, schedule, qualifications, and overall fit.
  • Coordinate with Contracts and internal stakeholders to support timely execution of NDAs, master agreements, and subcontracts.
  • Maintain visibility into active subconsultant engagements, available partner capacity, and performance.

Offshore and Extended Capacity Management (30%)

  • Provide operational leadership for DLB's offshore engineering and design resources.
  • Coordinate with technical and project leadership to forecast offshore resource demand and align resources with project needs.
  • Manage resource requests, allocation, onboarding, utilization, and capacity planning for offshore teams.
  • Serve as a central point of coordination between offshore resources, external partner leadership, and DLB Project Managers.
  • Monitor partner performance using established service levels, utilization metrics, and quality measures.
  • Coordinate resolution of resource, performance, and delivery issues with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop processes that enable DLB to scale external capacity efficiently as business demand changes.

Capacity Planning and Operational Excellence (20%)

  • Develop and maintain visibility into external capacity, utilization, capabilities, and project demand.
  • Partner with Design Department leadership to anticipate capacity gaps and develop external resource solutions.
  • Establish and continuously improve standardized processes for requesting, selecting, and evaluating external resources.
  • Develop reporting and performance metrics to support data-driven decisions regarding external capacity.
  • Identify opportunities to improve cost effectiveness, resource utilization, and speed of deployment.
  • Support development of policies, procedures, templates, and governance standards related to external partnerships.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Strategic Support (20%)

  • Build strong working relationships across Design, Contracts, Finance, and Business Development.
  • Communicate external resource availability, constraints, risks, and opportunities to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Support the Associate Director, Strategy & Growth in evaluating new strategic partnerships and external capabilities.
  • Participate in negotiations and commercial discussions with external partners as appropriate.
  • Assist in evaluating potential new partners based on technical capabilities, pricing, and organizational fit.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives related to external capacity, partner performance, and operational improvement.

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (Intermediate level for all the following)

Knowledge of:

  • The architecture, engineering, construction, or MEP consulting industry and project delivery environment.
  • RFP, proposal, fee estimate, and scope-of-work development and coordination.
  • Professional services contracts, subconsultant agreements, and fee structures.
  • Resource and capacity planning across multiple projects, disciplines, or geographies.

Skilled at:

  • Building and managing productive relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Evaluating pricing, scope, resource requirements, and partner capabilities.
  • Coordinating resources and priorities across multiple concurrent engagements.
  • Communicating, presenting, and negotiating with internal and external audiences.

Ability to:

  • Understand engineering project requirements and translate them into external resource solutions.
  • Analyze operational challenges, develop practical solutions, and drive implementation.
  • Manage multiple priorities, deadlines, partners, and concurrent requests.
  • Operate successfully in a remote environment through strong communication and self-motivation.
  • Grow into increasing levels of responsibility within a rapidly evolving organization.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position.
  • Frequently moving through office, facility, and other environments.
  • On occasion, may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 15%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel may include client sites, DLB offices, meetings with employees and external partners, partner facilities, business development activities, and industry conferences.

Education / Experience Requirements

  • B.A. / B.S. degree in engineering, construction management, architecture, business, or related discipline; engineering or technical degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of industry-related experience, with 5-7 years preferred.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience supporting proposals, RFPs, contracts, or commercial management within an engineering, architecture, construction, or professional services organization.
  • Experience within an MEP consulting engineering firm strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing subconsultants, vendors, outsourced resources, or offshore teams preferred.
  • Experience with data center, mission critical, or other technically complex project environments preferred.

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

​NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

Full-Stack AI Engineer

Location: Remote (India-based) — Bengaluru preferred; with meaningful daily overlap with our UK and US teams

Engagement Type: Full-time — permanent, ongoing

About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion & Coach — a guided AI assistant that helps early-learning educators plan lessons, discover the right materials, and improve classroom outcomes. We’re looking for a Full-Stack AI Engineer to help bring Audrey to life and shape where she goes next.

Role Overview

This is a role for an engineer who loves working where AI meets product. You’ll own the intelligence behind Audrey — the retrieval, generation, and logic that make her genuinely useful to teachers — while being just as comfortable moving across the backend and frontend to bring the whole experience together. You’ll work alongside our backend, infrastructure, and frontend engineers, with real ownership of the AI and real influence over what we build.

Audrey is approaching an exciting launch, and you’ll play a central part in shaping her — refining how she works today and helping define where she goes as we grow into more classrooms.

Just as much as the engineering, we care about instinct for the product. We’re looking for someone genuinely curious about the teachers we serve — an engineer who asks the right questions, understands how educators actually use what we build, and lets that understanding shape the experience. You’ll bring deep AI expertise, a natural instinct for collaboration, and a calm, considered approach to solving hard problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the AI at the heart of Audrey — retrieval, generation, and the models and logic that make her intelligent and dependable.
  • Craft an experience where teachers instantly find exactly the right video, printable, or activity, with retrieval that’s fast, accurate, and reliable.
  • Build and refine the content and data pipelines that power Audrey — ingesting and structuring videos, printables, guides, and multilingual content for precise retrieval.
  • Work across the full stack, connecting the AI seamlessly into the wider product alongside our backend and frontend engineers.
  • Shape how Audrey thinks, responds, and guides teachers — designing her behavior, personality, and overall experience with the end user always in mind.
  • Help bring Audrey to launch and shape her evolution as we scale.
  • Continuously raise the quality, speed, and reliability of Audrey’s responses and recommendations.
  • Build fluently with modern AI-assisted development tools to design, build, and iterate quickly.
  • Partner with our infrastructure lead to keep Audrey running smoothly and efficiently in the cloud.
  • Put in place the evaluation, testing, and monitoring that keep quality high, and keep technical documentation clear.
  • Collaborate closely and openly with engineering and product, sharing your thinking and progress early and often.
  • Help shape the product roadmap — from deeper personalization to multilingual support and classroom insights.
  • Build with privacy and safety in mind, including FERPA/COPPA alignment.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience across the full stack, comfortable working fluidly between backend and frontend.
  • Proven, hands-on depth with modern AI: you’ve personally built and shipped at least one production LLM/AI application. We know the LLM tooling is only a few years old — what you’ve actually built matters far more to us than years on a résumé.
  • Strong experience building retrieval-augmented (RAG) systems — embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and re-ranking — with a real feel for what makes retrieval accurate and dependable.
  • An AI-native engineer who builds fluently with modern AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor) and weaves AI through their workflow.
  • Strong Python and solid backend fundamentals (APIs, databases, data pipelines), with enough frontend ability to work end-to-end across the stack.
  • Practical LLM orchestration and prompt engineering (LangChain or comparable), including agent/tool design, system-prompt and persona design, and guardrails.
  • Solid AWS experience (compute, storage, databases, containers, monitoring); familiarity with managed model services (e.g. Amazon Bedrock) and/or self-hosted model inference is a plus.
  • A genuine product sensibility — you’re curious about the people who use what you build, and you let that shape your work.
  • A natural collaborator who communicates openly, builds trust across teams, and brings a calm, considered approach to a fast-moving environment.
  • Comfortable owning your work and driving it forward with minimal oversight.
  • Able to work remotely with meaningful overlap across UK and US time zones, with strong written communication.
  • Bonus: edtech or early-childhood education experience; multilingual retrieval; video/audio ML; familiarity with FERPA/COPPA or similar.

What We Offer

  • Competitive, market-aligned salary for an experienced engineer in India.
  • Fully remote, full-time role with flexibility over how you structure your day.
  • End-to-end ownership of the AI behind a flagship product, from launch through scale, with real influence over its architecture and roadmap.
  • A collaborative, family-friendly, mission-driven environment at the intersection of education, media, and technology.

Why Join Us

This is a rare chance to own the AI capabilities of a growing global education company at a defining moment. You’ll be the engineer who brings Audrey to life, shapes how she’s built, and helps take her from launch to a product used in thousands of classrooms. If you want work that’s visible, technically meaningful, and genuinely impactful for young learners and their teachers, this is it.

Note: This is an India-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.

MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. We pride ourselves on a supportive and mission-driven working environment.

CRO

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Strategy Ownership: Define and execute the end-to-end revenue strategy, aligning sales processes, targets, and pipelines to the growth goals of US-based clients.

Sales Leadership: Lead and manage the sales function day-to-day — setting priorities, coaching the team, and holding performance accountable against clear metrics.

Pipeline Development: Build and maintain a healthy, qualified sales pipeline by identifying new opportunities, overseeing outreach, and guiding deals from first contact through close.

Client Relationship Management: Serve as a senior point of contact for key accounts, establishing trust and ensuring long-term retention and expansion.

Process & Playbook Design: Develop repeatable, scalable sales processes and documentation that the team can execute consistently across US company targets.

Performance Reporting: Track and report on revenue KPIs, providing visibility into what is working, what is not, and where to course-correct.

Requirements

Required Experience & Skills

5 or more years of experience in sales, with a track record of hitting or exceeding revenue targets — ideally within or selling into US-based companies.

Demonstrated experience managing or leading a sales function, not just contributing as an individual performer.

Strong command of the full sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, negotiation, and closing.

Clear, confident communicator in English — written and verbal — with the ability to engage C-suite and senior stakeholders.

Comfort working in a remote, async-first environment with US-based teams.

Perfect Fit / Culture

Owns outcomes end-to-end — you do not wait to be told what needs attention; you identify it and act.

Communicates proactively and precisely across time zones, keeping stakeholders informed without being prompted.

Comfortable operating at both the strategic and executional level — equally at home designing a sales playbook and jumping on a closing call.

Brings a coaching mindset to the team: you raise others' performance, not just your own.

Typical Day

You start the day by reviewing pipeline health and flagging any deals that need attention before the US business day opens. Mid-morning, you join a sync with the sales team to unblock blockers and align on daily priorities. The rest of your day splits between async work — refining outreach sequences, reviewing proposals, updating reporting — and live calls with US-based prospects or clients. You are the connective tissue between strategy and execution, which means no two days are identical, but the rhythm of pipeline review, team touchpoints, and stakeholder communication stays consistent.

Salary / Hours / Location

Working Hours: Overlap with US business hours required.

Location: Philippines, Pakistan, or Latin America — fully remote.

Every Pavago candidate goes through an AI rating pass, a recruiter screen, and a client interview before placement. This ensures that only candidates who are genuinely qualified and well-matched reach the client's desk.

Can you walk us through a specific revenue target you owned — what it was, how you approached it, and whether you hit it?

How have you built or improved a sales process from scratch? What did you inherit, what did you change, and what were the results?

Describe your experience selling into or working with US-based companies. How did you navigate time zone differences and cultural expectations?

Have you managed or led a sales team? How did you handle a situation where a team member was consistently underperforming?

What sales tools and CRMs have you worked with, and how do you use data to prioritize your pipeline?

The Social Media Video Editor & Designer at CapsLock creates engaging, platform-first video content for TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook.

The role is primarily focused on short-form video editing — turning raw footage into polished, dynamic videos through strong pacing, storytelling, transitions, captions, sound, and motion graphics.

It also calls for solid graphic design skills to produce supporting static assets such as graphics, thumbnails, overlays, and other visual elements when needed.

Working closely with the social media team, this person keeps content aligned with brand guidelines, marketing objectives, and platform best practices — while staying on top of new editing styles, creative formats, and social media trends.

Video Editing & Post-Production

Graphic Design & Creative Development

  • Create motion graphics and supporting design assets, including overlays, text animations, thumbnails, static posts, and Stories.

  • Experience with motion graphics, animation, or advanced visual effects.

About the Role

Are you a fresher looking to start your career in Logistics & Operations Associate ?

We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented

Logistics & Operations Associate to join our team. This is a great opportunity for someone who is confident with Microsoft Excel, enjoys coordinating with people, and wants to build a career in logistics and operations.

You don't need any prior logistics, supply chain, or operations experience. If you are a quick learner with strong Excel skills, good communication skills, and a proactive attitude, we would love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do

As a Logistics & Operations Associate you will learn and support day-to-day logistics operations, including:

  • Coordinate with transporters, warehouses, production teams, and internal teams.

  • Track shipments and follow up on pickups and deliveries.

  • Update shipment status and maintain tracking sheets in Microsoft Excel.

  • Follow up with transport partners on pending or delayed shipments.

  • Coordinate with warehouse and production teams to ensure goods are ready for dispatch.

  • Maintain shipping records, invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans, and other documents.

  • Monitor movement of goods and report any discrepancies.

  • Communicate with different stakeholders regarding shipment updates.

  • Prepare daily and weekly logistics reports.

  • Maintain organized records of shipments and logistics documentation.

  • Assist the team with import/export documentation when required.

  • Escalate delays, damages, or other operational issues to the reporting manager.

  • Learn and follow company logistics processes and documentation requirements.

Who Can Apply?

Freshers are strongly encouraged to apply! No previous logistics, supply chain, or operations experience is required.

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Are a fresher or starting your first professional job.

  • Have strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel – this is the main technical requirement for the role.

  • Are comfortable working with spreadsheets, data, and tracking reports.

  • Have good written and verbal communication skills.

  • Can write professional emails.

  • Are organized and good at follow-ups.

  • Pay attention to details and accuracy.

  • Can coordinate with multiple people and teams.

  • Are willing to learn logistics and supply chain processes.

  • Take ownership of assigned tasks and follow them through to completion.

  • Are available to join immediately or at short notice.

Excel Skills We’re Looking For

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are mandatory. Candidates should be comfortable using VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF formulas, data analysis, and other Excel functions for day-to-day work.

What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to start your career in Logistics & Supply Chain

  • Hands-on exposure to real-world logistics operations

  • Opportunity to work with transporters, warehouses, production teams, and internal stakeholders

  • Learn shipment tracking, documentation, Excel reporting, and coordination

  • Supportive environment to develop professional and operational skills

  • Opportunity to grow with the company based on performance

Gusti Leder creates natural leather products that combine quality, functionality, sustainability, and timeless design. Our product range includes bags, backpacks, accessories, stationery, and other leather goods.

We believe in slow fashion, transparent production, durable products, and responsible partnerships with local producers. We work closely with our production partners to maintain quality and ethical standards.

Why Join Gusti Leder?

This role is more than just shipment tracking. It is an opportunity to learn how logistics and operations work in a growing international business.

If you are a fresher who is organized, eager to learn, comfortable with Excel, and enjoys coordinating with people, this could be a great starting point for your career.

🚀 Interested?

Freshers are strongly encouraged to apply.

If you are confident with Excel, have good communication skills, and are ready to learn, we'd love to hear from you!

Immediate joiners will be preferred.

This role is situated in a dynamic and fast-paced product development environment, characterized by a sense of urgency and resource constraints. This role calls for exceptional leadership, tactical & strategic thinking, strong background in the program and operations, financial acumen, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Financial Management:

  • Leading the monthly financial submission process while implementing robust controls and governance frameworks.
